about: Pre-registered TEST candidates. Committed before any imagery of these places was opened; the draw hashes the commit that added this file. Administrative data only. OSM-derived names and codes: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.

rules.municipalityIndex: i = BigInt("0x" + sha256_hex(utf8("<listCommit>:<stratum>"))) mod n, where listCommit is the full hash of the commit that added this file and n the number of eligible candidates of the stratum in file order
rules.cellIndex: j = BigInt("0x" + sha256_hex(utf8("<listCommit>:<stratum>:cell:<code>"))) mod m, over the eligible cells of the municipality in grid order
rules.order: strata are drawn in the order of this file
rules.eligibleMunicipality: centre at least minDistanceKm from every zone of zones/registry.json (any role, TEST zones drawn before included) and every seen site listed there, and its region not in excludedRegions for the stratum
rules.grid: square cells of cellSizeKm ground km laid from the south-west corner of the municipality bounding box, rows south to north, cells west to east within a row
rules.eligibleCell: cell centre inside the municipality boundary, at least minDistanceKm from every protected site, and at least cellMinShare of a 21 x 21 lattice of points (50 m spacing) inside the stratum features (OSM, fetched at draw time and saved next to the draw)
rules.next: if the municipality has no eligible cell, or (hard stratum) the Esri metadata at the cell centre does not meet the condition, or the zone has fewer than minPools pools after the blind review (all strata except negative), take i + 1 mod n and repeat
rules.hardCondition: Esri World Imagery metadata at the cell centre (World_Imagery MapServer layer 9, "30cm Resolution Metadata", the z19 level; SRC_DATE2): capture date from November to February, or solar elevation at local solar noon on the capture date below 35 degrees (90 - |lat - d|, d = 23.44 * sin(360 / 365 * (284 + day of year)) degrees)
rules.acquisition: Esri strata: the capture (SRC_DATE2 and SRC_DESC) at the cell centre differs from every DEV and DEV-2 Esri zone. PNOA and IGN: excluded regions below (provinces and departments of DEV, DEV-2, GOLD and training zones). DGT 2025: one national flight, the distance rule applies

strata.definition: Portuguese municipalities of the districts Braga (03), Braganca (04), Porto (13), Viana do Castelo (16) and Vila Real (17), first two digits of the INE code, population at least 15000 (OSM population tag, 2021 census). Centre: OSM relation bounding-box centre.
Portuguese mainland municipalities of every other district (01 to 18 except the five above), population at least 15000 (OSM population tag, 2021 census). Centre: OSM relation bounding-box centre.

Spanish municipalities with population 10000 to 100000 (OSM population tag), except the Canary Islands (35, 38), Ceuta (51) and Melilla (52), and except the provinces in excludedRegions (acquisition rule). Centre: OSM relation bounding-box centre.
